title: Setup registers a project in relay's own projects.toml
what: The project registry lives under $RELAY_HOME (per machine), not in relay's checkout; setup never writes a tracked file of relay itself; an existing registry in the checkout is read once and moved, with one line saying so.
why: Found 30 Oct by the trial of relay on a copy of relay cleaned of relay (owner, 30 Oct: "Полагаю что для текущих задач будет не лишним проверить подключение relay к самому relay, очищенному от relay"); sandbox HOME, RELAY_HOME and RELAY_PROJECTS, claude stubbed. lib/relay_config.py:22-23: with no RELAY_PROJECTS set, projects_file defaults to <relay checkout>/projects.toml, a file tracked in relay's repository, so registering any project (from a sandbox, another machine or a newcomer) edits relay's tracked file; nothing says so.
failing_case: With RELAY_PROJECTS unset, `relay setup` in a fresh repo adds an entry to /Users/amidman/relay/projects.toml (git status of relay shows it modified).
pass_cases: setup with RELAY_PROJECTS unset writes only under $RELAY_HOME
relay's own checkout stays clean after setup of another project
an old registry in the checkout is moved once with a line

question: Where do relay's settings live once the project registry leaves relay's repository (review F3)? Today projects.toml in relay's git holds the owner's settings (paid cap $200/day, native language Russian, the global rules file and skip list) and each project's settings (relay: lanes 6, rules loaded: principles, python).
options: a. split by owner: the owner's settings and the list of projects on this machine in ~/.relay; a project's own settings (lanes, rules it loads) in that project's own .relay/ folder in its git; relay's repository ships only defaults
b. everything in ~/.relay (what the fix built): one file; nothing travels with a project's repository, so on a new machine the owner sets lanes, cap and language again
c. keep projects.toml in relay's repository: relay setup on any new project changes relay's own repository (the defect the clean-relay trial found)
